current_host_findings.safe_fix: Introduce an explicit account-bound durable selection DTO/preferences owner preserving selected values and nil/unknown states; load through existing profile identity and keep capability catalog supplied by provider. current_host_findings.impact: A future service adapter cannot distinguish immutable accepted metadata from a later queued-settings update using current map alone. Existing deterministic text producer does not use config, so it is not currently executing with a wrong model.
current_host_findings.safe_fix: Keep immutable accepted snapshots. Define a separate scope/session/revision-bound pending-configuration operation/provider interface only when implementing this frontend capability; pending success/failure must remain explicit. Exact target-selection/merge/reconnect behavior stays independently specified until mobile service owner is closed.

recommended_minimum_batch.work: Persist current editable selection with account+host+destination scope; preserve null selections, reject corrupt snapshot without overwriting source, and surface save failure.
Add regression vectors for queue/steer accepted configuration retention through mode toggle, cancel, explicit start, FIFO start and fresh history owner; do not add fake backend execution.

Keep queued settings update as explicit capability/operation boundary. A deterministic test adapter may simulate acceptance/failure only with separate effective state and clear independent semantics. Do not overwrite configurationByIntent as a shortcut.

validation_vectors: Scope A and B with equal thread names remain isolated across new preference owner/account boundaries.
Unsent selection survives process-owner reconstruction, distinct from last accepted intent config.
Queue accepted under config A keeps audit A after current selection changes to B; explicit later queued update is a separate operation.
FIFO/explicit start preserve pending intent identity and snapshot; cancel/mode-toggle invalidate old acknowledgements without deleting audit.
Unreadable preference file does not reset-and-overwrite original; failed save does not masquerade as accepted setting.
Legacy history missing configurationByIntent remains decodable.
